grid.land_source: Natural Earth 1:10m land v5.1.1 (ne_10m_land.zip sha256 e547d749445eaa0964aba76738090ec88f5e63c4585122170f98c67a7ea922dc), clipped per 1deg cell in lon/lat, area in EPSG:6933

unit.label: Aqua MODIS daytime detections per 1,000 km² of land per month (2003–2011 average)
unit.definition: counts[i][m-1] is the TOTAL number of detections in cell i in calendar month m summed over the period (all n_years). Display value = counts[i][m-1] / n_years / land_km2 x 1000, with land_km2 = belt.cells[i][4]. All year: sum of the 12 counts / n_years / land_km2 x 1000 (detections per 1,000 km2 per year). Counts are satellite detections, not fires.

sparse_rule.definition: Bit m-1 (m = 1..12) is set when the cell-month has at least one detection AND (its period total is < 10 OR it had detections in <= 2 of the 9 years). Bit 12 applies the same rule to the cell's all-year total and the number of years with any detection. A zero count is never sparse: it means no detections reported.

inputs.role: land_km2 per 1 degree cell (via belt.json cells)

notes: 0 means no Aqua detections were reported in that calendar month in any year of the period; it is not proof of no fire.
Daytime detections only (FIRMS daynight = D). Night-time detections are excluded, so totals are lower than belt.json (day and night).
Single sensor (Aqua MODIS), native counts; not harmonized with VIIRS or Terra (Terra has a different overpass time).
A 2003–2011 average of a historical record (FIRMS standard archive), not real-time and not a forecast.
Sparse cell-months (see sparse_rule) rest on very few detections or years; one big year can dominate a 9-year average.
Calendar months are UTC months and differ in length (28–31 days); values are not normalised per day.
Same land cells as belt.json (>= 500 km2 land). 8367 daytime detections fell in omitted cells: excluded from cells, included in bands.
FIRMS country archives drop detections not assigned to a country; coastal cells may be undercounted.
